title: Cloud Lab 1 — Application Performance
description: Application measurements alongside the resource dashboard. Two-minute rate/latency windows smooth short runs; run history keeps exact operation counts. Trace detail is selected, metrics count all reported operations.

panels.title: Application scrape health
panels.description: Exporter reachability, separate from workload and database availability. Only fresh samples are shown; retired targets remain available in historical data.

panels.title: Active experiment
panels.description: Controller global slot. Includes starting and stopping; one experiment at a time.

panels.title: Workload elapsed time
panels.description: Actual reported elapsed time; unavailable while idle.

panels.title: 01 / HTTP PERFORMANCE · includes status polling, excludes probes
HTTP requests by route
panels.description: Includes browser status polling, identified by its route. Probes, scrapes and assets are excluded.

panels.title: HTTP p95 latency
panels.description: Response-header latency, not asynchronous experiment duration. Sparse traffic makes percentile estimates coarse.

panels.title: HTTP error responses
panels.description: 4xx rejections and 5xx failures remain separately labelled.

panels.title: 02 / WORKLOAD ACTIVITY · reported operations and payload bytes
Actual workload operation rate
panels.description: All reported operations, regardless of trace sampling. Cycle failures and failed individual calls are distinct series, not additive totals.

panels.title: Data payload throughput
panels.description: Payload bytes read by Data; excludes protocol overhead. Container network traffic is on the Resources dashboard.

panels.title: Aggregate Compute calculation throughput
panels.description: Actual calculation units per second across Compute instances; run and batch IDs are not metric labels.

panels.title: 03 / EXECUTION & OUTCOMES · background work, separate from Start
Workload execution p95
panels.description: Worker process lifetime, including startup and cleanup. A single run gives a coarse histogram estimate; exact durations remain in history.

panels.title: I/O p95 latency
panels.description: Full streamed network transfer or MongoDB call. Includes calls omitted from readable traces.

panels.title: Run outcomes in displayed range
panels.description: Controller-observed terminal transitions. Prometheus increase is extrapolated; exact experiment lists remain in history.
